name: utility-optimizer-crm
description: Utility Optimizer CRM: energy switching and Worldpay merchant-services sales, renewals and compliance.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @uo/shared && npm run build -w @uo/api && npm run build -w @uo/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @uo/shared && npm run start:dev -w @uo/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @uo/shared && npm run typecheck -w @uo/api && npm run typecheck -w @uo/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @uo/shared && npm run test -w @uo/api
scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w @uo/shared && npm run test:unit -w @uo/api
